bibl.title: Early Christian Gospels: Their Production and Transmission
bibl.seg: Scott D. Charlesworth, Early Christian Gospels: Their Production and Transmission = Papyrologica Florentina. XLVII.
Firenze, Gonnelli, 2016, xxii-326 pp., figg., 32 pll. ISBN 978-88-7468-048-1. €120.

C.R. par J.K. Elliott, NT 60 (2018) pp. 94-98. - Juan Chapa, Aegyptus 99 (2019) pp. 307-313. - James R. Royse, BASP 58 (2021) pp. 461-469 [concerne aussi: Alan Mugridge, Copying Early Christian Texts: A Study of Scribal Practice].
bibl.note: Preface. - 1. The early gospel manuscript tradition. - 2. Public and private: early Christian codicological conventions. - Excursus 1: Codicology and the dating of early c[anonical] gospel papyri. - 3. Consensus standardization in the systematic approach to nomina sacra in early c gospels; - Excursus 2: Nomina sacra in fragmentary c gospel papyri. - 4. Private and marginal: early n[on-canonical] gospels and possible n gospel fragments. - 5. Textual fluidity in early c gospel MSS. - 6. Textual originality in early n gospels. - 7. The recent historiography of early Christianity. - Excursus 3. Defining ancient literacy: the Egyptian evidence. - Bibliography. Indexes.
